info.name: QuantReplay REST API
info.description: Manual REST checks for the QuantReplay market simulator (venue XETRA). Docs: https://quod-financial.github.io/quantreplay/RESTAPI/RESTAPI.html

item.name: Price seeds (external DB sync)

request.description:
Fully empties all XETRA order books:
1. sets persistenceEnabled=false and orderOnStartup=false,
2. resets the venue (books cleared, FIX sessions reconnect). The generator stays stopped.

To fill the book again: Order generation -> Start generator.
To use Store/Recover again: Persisted market state -> 1. Enable persistence (+ reset).

exec: // 1) Turn off persistence (no restore from XETRA_state.json) and auto-start of the generator after reset
header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ persistenceEnabled: false, orderOnStartup: false }) } },
(err, res) => { if (err || res.code !== 200) console.log('Disable persistence failed', err || res.code); });

item.name: Market phases
item.description:
Real phases supported by QuantReplay: Open, Closed, PreOpen, PreClose, Auction, TradeAtLast, Halted.
There is no 'PostAuction' phase: after the closing auction (PreClose) comes TradeAtLast (Post-Trading).

Each request sets a one-phase schedule from now for {{phaseMinutes}} min and resets the venue.
FIX tag 625 (TradingSessionSubID) per phase: PreOpen=2, Open=3, PreClose=4, TradeAtLast=5, Auction=6, Closed=10.
During an auction call: 326=3; at uncrossing: 326=2.

Every request also sends "name": "{{venueId}}" (the same value, nothing changes): a body with only "phases" is rejected with 400 "Required fields missing for Venue model in request" - BUG-003 (bug_reports/BUG-003-phase-schedule-only-update-returns-400.md).

item.name: Datasources (historical playback)
item.description:
Plays back historical bid/ask levels from CSV into the matching engine; they match against random (synthetic) or your manual FIX orders.

CSV on host: ~/fintech-project/sim-run/xetra/datasources/xetra_vow_history.csv
In container: {{datasourceFile}}
1 row = full order book snapshot: ReceivedTimeStamp, MessageTimeStamp, Symbol + 3 depth levels per side (BidParty_1/BidQuantity_1/BidPrice_1/AskPrice_1/AskQuantity_1/AskParty_1, then level 2 and 3). 10 rows, VOW, 3 s apart. Parties: every order has its own party, CP1 ... CP60, row by row in column order (row 1: bid 1 = CP1, ask 1 = CP2 ... ask 3 = CP6; row 2: CP7 ...), returned as contra party (448, 452=17) in fills. Timestamp format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.MMM

Column mapping: columnFrom = simulator field, columnTo = CSV column; '#' = depth level, so 'BidPrice#' -> 'BidPrice_#' maps BidPrice_1, BidPrice_2, BidPrice_3. maxDepthLevels = 3.

Demo: subscribe to VOW market data, run 3 and 4, then send Buy 1000 VOW @ 68.94 limit within 3 s: fills 420 @ 68.90 (CP2) + 580 @ 68.92 (CP4).

Order: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.

request.description: Reloads venue settings from DB. Clears current order books (restored from persistence file if enabled), restarts FIX/REST engines: FIX sessions reconnect.
